scope: Task 2 parser and uncertainty definitions; full evaluation, calibration, routing, recovery, and cost decisions remain draft
effective_when: Approved and committed; subsequent method changes require a recorded protocol revision

reference_parser.scoring: Official parsing and correctness labels are preserved; successful parsing is not correctness

parser_statuses.calls: at least one valid parsed call
parser_statuses.no_calls: visible output is exactly [] after trimming whitespace
parser_statuses.unparsed_or_no_call: other nonempty output without parsed calls; tool intent is not inferred
parser_statuses.parse_failure: parser exception or invalid parsed-call structure

scores.max_token_surprisal: max(-log p_i) over visible chosen tokens

validity: all visible chosen-token byte arrays exactly reconstruct the UTF-8 response
all visible chosen-token log-probabilities are finite
saved token count, spans, end-token exclusion and numeric scores agree with recomputed evidence

end_token_exclusion.rule: Remove only one final allowed token when full bytes differ and removing it yields exact visible-output byte alignment

single_sample.parser_dependency: Whole-output scores can remain valid for complete nonempty responses without a parsed call

meaningful_token.formula: -sum(log p_i for selected visible tokens) / selected_token_count
validity: nonempty visible response with exact byte-aligned finite chosen-token evidence
source-reconstructed calls equal the pinned parser calls under the type-aware canonical key
at least one visible token overlaps a supported source span

supported_formats.bfcl_v3: Complete Python call or list of calls, plain or dotted tool names, literal keyword values; positional arguments, expansions and unsupported string syntax are rejected
supported_formats.rotbench: One ReAct Action or Action Code name followed by one Action Input or Action Code Input JSON object; trailing text, multiple actions and duplicate JSON keys at any depth are rejected
supported_formats.tooleyes: Same bounded single-action ReAct rule as rotbench
supported_formats.apibank: One standalone or fenced JSON object containing only name and parameters, optionally with the audited bounded thought/prose prefix; or one audited fenced toolcall layout with a JSON argument object. Duplicate JSON keys at any depth and parser disagreement are rejected
supported_formats.toolalpaca: Unavailable for all outputs under the scoped exclusion

meaningful_token.selected_spans: Tool names, argument names and argument values from the supported source layout; simple nonempty string quotes are excluded, while empty-string quotes represent the value
meaningful_token.bfcl_composite_values: The full literal value span is selected, including its internal punctuation; JSON layouts select scalar/key atoms instead
meaningful_token.token_selection: A visible token overlapping any selected byte span is included in full once
meaningful_token.boundary_metadata: Selected-token indices, source spans and tokens extending outside the selected spans are retained
meaningful_token.unsupported_layout: Record an unavailable score and reason; do not infer a span from parser success or an official correct score
meaningful_token.eligible_comparisons: Report eligible and ineligible counts; meaningful-token comparisons apply only where this measure is available

repeated_sample.scope: The existing 30-case development diagnostic only; new evaluation subsets require a recorded revision

scores.exact_string_entropy_nats: Same entropy formula over exact visible-output clusters with incomplete/error status keys
scores.exact_string_disagreement: Same disagreement formula over exact visible-output clusters with incomplete/error status keys

repeated_sample.denominator: All ten slots, including explicit parser, empty, truncated and request-error outcomes
repeated_sample.invalid_probability_evidence: Complete visible text retains its canonical/parser outcome for probability-free clustering; token-probability scores stay invalid

unavailable_evidence.numeric_imputation: none; unavailable scores have a status and reason, never a numeric zero or substituted measure
unavailable_evidence.reporting: Retain all cases in request and correctness summaries; report score eligibility and use eligible cases for score-specific numeric metrics
unavailable_evidence.future_routing: A gate response to missing evidence requires a separate Task 4 rule before held-out routing evaluation

decision_context.timing: Chosen after development outputs were inspected; no held-out perturbation groups were used to design these methods
decision_context.bfcl_evidence: 20 saved development responses across four model pilots; chosen-token records remain in Drive
decision_context.freeze_review_correction: Reject duplicate ReAct JSON keys, including nested keys, because overwritten values do not provide trusted complete call alignment. Synthetic regression cases cover both supported ReAct benchmarks.
decision_context.limits: Development eligibility and implementation evidence do not establish official accuracy, population format coverage, detection quality, or routing benefit
